scope: Diagnostic-only small-voxel Gaussian diagonal AR1 parametric bootstrap; no production inference API or gate change.

candidate.estimator: original unrestricted OLS-based Gls.prepare AR1 (iterations1, stationaritybound.99), followed by fixedrank GLS
candidate.mean: X times original restricted coefficients, including nuisance
candidate.parameters: Original fitted rho and per-run sample covariance of run-centered synchronized unrestricted GLS innovation residuals after marginalHC2, on within-estimation-segment nonfirst rows; denominatorK-1.
candidate.temporal_policy: Independent stationary physical-run starts; latent process continues through omitted observations and retained noise-exclusion rows; observed rows selected afterward. Estimator whitening reset policy unchanged.
candidate.refit: Re-estimate AR and global fixedrank coefficients each replicate; generator parameters fixed at original estimates.
candidate.intervals: two-sided95percent type7 marginalpercentiles; all12 coefficients/contrasts computed perreplicate
candidate.covariance_admission: Finite stable AR; positive-definite Sigma/Gamma through Gale Cholesky; no jitter/floor; first failure retained, no retry or substitution.

development.data: Original400 baseline responses, exact existing generator and response hashes
development.use: Exploratory mechanism diagnosis; cannot qualify the candidate.

fresh.checkpoint_policy: Evaluate only when all four settings reach checkpoint. Reject if any simultaneous interval lies wholly outside band. No early acceptance.
fresh.final_acceptance: All48 adjusted intervals wholly inside band atN2000; zero failedfits/replicates; complete schedule. Passing establishes approximate calibration within declared band for these settings only.
fresh.final_inconclusive: AtN2000 neither rejection nor full acceptance. No extra datasets, relaxedband or posthoc correction.
fresh.failure_policy: First computation failure makes admission fail; distinguish computational failure from statistical rejection. All attemptedrows retained.
fresh.timeout_policy: 7200second wall cap for entire freshstage, includingallcheckpoints; timeout is incomplete qualification and cannot pass.

stress.use: Descriptive misspecification/boundary results outside acceptance family; nopromotion.

review: Independent scientific expert approved generative law, matrix controls, invariants and familywise checkpoint rules before new development or fresh study outputs.
